content.value_statement: Fragile tests often verify mocks instead of real behavior. This skill gives practical rules for safer mocks, cleaner production code, and stronger TDD habits.
actual_capabilities: Identifies tests that assert on mock elements instead of user-visible behavior.
Explains why test-only methods should stay out of production classes.
Guides users to understand dependency side effects before adding mocks.
Recommends complete mock data that mirrors real API responses.
Encourages writing tests as part of implementation through a TDD cycle.
Provides a quick reference for common test design mistakes and fixes.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run test suites or inspect repositories automatically.
It does not replace framework-specific testing documentation.
It cannot prove a mock is complete without accurate real API examples.
It assumes the user can evaluate whether integration tests are practical.

use_cases.title: Review a New Unit Test
use_cases.description: Check whether assertions verify real behavior or only confirm that mocks were rendered.

use_cases.title: Plan Safer Test Utilities
use_cases.description: Move cleanup helpers out of production classes and into dedicated test support code.

use_cases.title: Improve Mock Strategy in Reviews
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether mocked dependencies preserve required side effects and response shape.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Simple Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one test case.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-anti-patterns skill to review this test. Tell me if it tests real behavior or mock behavior, and suggest one improvement.

prompt_templates.title: Review Mock Usage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of mocks and dependency boundaries.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the testing-anti-patterns checklist to these tests. Identify mocks that hide important side effects or should move to a lower level.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Production API Pollution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of test-only production methods.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the testing-anti-patterns skill to find methods added mainly for tests. Recommend test utilities or lifecycle ownership changes instead.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Test Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Using the testing-anti-patterns guidance, design a test strategy for this feature. Include where to use real components, where to mock, and how to avoid incomplete fixtures.

output_examples.input: A component test asserts that a sidebar mock test ID is present.
output_examples.output: The review should flag this as mock behavior testing. It should recommend asserting on real navigation behavior or avoiding the mock.

output_examples.input: A production session class adds a cleanup method used only by tests.
output_examples.output: The review should recommend moving cleanup into test utilities and checking whether the session owns the resource lifecycle.

output_examples.input: A mocked API response includes only the field used by the current assertion.
output_examples.output: The review should ask for the documented response shape and recommend a complete fixture with downstream fields.

best_practices: Write or inspect the failing test before deciding what to mock.
Mock at the lowest useful boundary while preserving behavior the test needs.
Keep test cleanup and fixtures in test support code unless production owns that behavior.
anti_patterns: Asserting that a mock exists instead of checking user-visible behavior.
Adding methods to production classes only to make tests easier.
Creating partial mocks without checking the real data structure.

faq.question: Does this skill write tests for me?
faq.answer: No. It guides test design decisions and helps review tests for common anti-patterns.

faq.question: Can I still use mocks?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill recommends using mocks only after understanding the dependency and preserving needed behavior.

faq.question: Why avoid testing mock elements?
faq.answer: Mock assertions often prove only that the mock exists. They may not prove the real component works.

faq.question: When should cleanup live outside production code?
faq.answer: Cleanup should live in test utilities when it exists only for tests and is not part of the production lifecycle.

faq.question: How does this skill treat integration tests?
faq.answer: It suggests integration tests when mock setup becomes more complex than testing real components.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
